nodes.title: Mathematical formulas for nth derivatives
nodes.description: Document the mathematical formulas for the nth derivatives of sin(x) and cos(x). The nth derivative of sin(x) with respect to x follows the cyclic pattern: sin(x), cos(x), -sin(x), -cos(x), sin(x), ... with period 4. This can be expressed as: d^n/dx^n sin(x) = sin(x + n*pi/2). Similarly, d^n/dx^n cos(x) = cos(x + n*pi/2). These formulas follow from the fundamental derivative relationships d/dx sin(x) = cos(x) and d/dx cos(x) = -sin(x).
nodes.expected_output: Mathematical documentation establishing that sin^(n)(x) = sin(x + n*pi/2) and cos^(n)(x) = cos(x + n*pi/2), providing the theoretical foundation for the implementation.

nodes.title: Implement _eval_derivative_n_times for sin class
nodes.description: Add the `_eval_derivative_n_times` method to the `sin` class in the trigonometric.py file. The method signature is `_eval_derivative_n_times(self, s, n)` where `s` is the symbol to differentiate with respect to and `n` is the number of derivatives. Implementation: if the argument equals `s`, return `sin(self.args[0] + n*pi/2)`. Otherwise return `None` to fall back to sympy's default repeated differentiation. The method should be added after the existing methods in the sin class, before the class definition ends.
nodes.expected_output: The complete modified Python file with the `_eval_derivative_n_times` method added to the `sin` class. The method returns sin(arg + n*pi/2) when differentiating with respect to the argument variable.

Implementation: if the argument equals `s`, return `cos(self.args[0] + n*pi/2)`. Otherwise return `None` to fall back to sympy's default repeated differentiation. The method should be added after the existing methods in the cos class, before the class definition ends.
nodes.expected_output: The complete modified Python file with the `_eval_derivative_n_times` method added to both the `sin` and `cos` classes. The file should be complete from the first import to the last line, with both trigonometric functions now supporting efficient nth derivative computation.
